The decisive mistake was made by InformationVerification_Expert at step 8. It had already seen the `span id='Discography'` lookup fail at step 7, but its "fix" kept the same unverified assumption: that the discography list is the `<ul>` sibling of a header. When that returned an empty list at step 9, the team had no data and no check on the selector. Its code also returned `None` silently when the section wasn't found, so the failure looked like "no albums matched" rather than "the parser found the wrong element."
